title: ProgressionRanks
description: Clean rank + permission management with prefixes/suffixes—built for stable server setups.
body:
# ProgressionRanks

Permissions chaos kills server management. ProgressionRanks is built to be predictable: ranks, prefixes/suffixes, and permission behavior that stays consistent. If you’re tired of “why does this work for one rank but not the other?”, this is the system you want.

# Highlights:

Rank/group structure with clean permission handling

Prefix/suffix identity for chat and roles

Designed for reliability in bigger setups

Perfect for: networks, staff systems, role-based servers.

# Why you’ll love it

Permissions stop being random and start being reliable

Clean rank identity through prefix/suffix

Designed for bigger setups where stability matters

### Basic workflow

Reload rank configs after edits:

/pranks reload

List ranks/groups:

/pranks list

Set a player’s rank:

/pranks set <player> <rank>

Add an extra rank/group (if supported by your setup):

/pranks add <player> <rank>

Remove a rank/group:

/pranks remove <player> <rank>

Show a player’s current rank/info:

/pranks info <player>

### Common usage

Create ranks in your config (prefix/suffix + permissions).

Assign ranks to players via commands (or via your sync workflow).

Verify in-game: chat prefix + permission checks.

If your actual command aliases differ, send your /pranks help output and I’ll rewrite this section exactly to match your plugin.

# Features

Rank/group structure with permission handling

Prefix/suffix formatting support

Built for consistent behavior in networks

# Setup

Install the plugin

Define ranks/groups and permissions

Assign users or sync via your workflow

Test rank changes and permission application

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Works in multi-server environments (when configured properly)
